item.description: At least seven people have been killed, including a 14-year-old boy, during drone attacks across Russia and Ukraine. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: 'Makeshift' treatment areas and long waits reported at major Adelaide hospital ED
item.description: Patients waited more than 13 hours to be treated at the biggest emergency department in Adelaide's northern suburbs, which has been operating at "crisis" levels for months, according to SA's doctors' union. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Isabella Carbone

item.title: Man dies after fall at Hanging Rock summit
item.description: The tourist spot will be closed over the long weekend following a deadly fall on Friday afternoon. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Police lay 115 additional charges on Sydney alleged childcare abuser
item.description: Former Sydney childcare worker Hamish Tait is now 444 facing charges related to the alleged abuse of children over a 16-year period. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Late Brazil goal denies Socceroos famous win after stunning Irankunda free kick
item.description: Brazil scored with the last touch of the game to deny the Socceroos a famous victory in Townsville, after a stunning free kick from Nestory Irankunda gave the Socceroos the lead. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Simon Smale

item.title: Red-hot Roosters roar into NRL grand final
item.description: The Roosters are the first team through to the NRL grand final after dismantling the Dolphins at Lang Park. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Father rejects coroner's conclusion on newborn son's death
item.description: A Queensland father says he will seek to have the findings of an inquest into his five-day-old son's death set aside. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Danielle Jesser

item.title: 'Evil' Catholic priest who sexually abused girls in foster care jailed
item.description: Robert Hickman, now aged 81, had already served time in New South Wales for similar offences, with the court hearing that he first started abusing children in the late 1970s. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: David Weber

item.title: 'He will be finished': Toplace lawyer's promise to fugitive developer
item.description: The former underling of disgraced developer Jean Nassif has denied in ICAC he was part of a campaign to smear the state's building commissioner. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Chantelle Al-Khouri

item.title: Eagles keep Dons winless, Dogs put Power on the brink
item.description: Essendon slumps to a 0–7 record after a final-quarter fightback against West Coast fell short, while the Bulldogs beat Port to move to 5–2. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Officer cleared of DV charges but 'not a finding complainant has lied'
item.description: A police security officer is acquitted of domestic violence charges, but an Adelaide judge has said that does not mean the "complainant has lied in her evidence". Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Eva Blandis

item.title: Former foster carers heartbroken after death of baby girl in Ballarat
item.description: The former foster carers of an eight-month-old baby girl who died days after being returned to her biological parents say the entire child protection system needs to be demolished and rebuilt from the ground up. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Eden Hynninen and Coco Veldkamp

item.title: Company pleads guilty over mechanic's death in 2023
item.description: A mining maintenance company in Western Australia's Goldfields has pleaded guilty over the death of a worker nearly three years ago. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jarrod Lucas

item.title: Albury childcare centre shut down as safety probe launched
item.description: The NSW independent regulator in early education and child care has shut down an Albury childcare service for six months while it investigates alleged child safety risks. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Philippe Perez

item.title: Fishtailing caravan captured on truckie dash cam prompts holiday warning
item.description: Dash-cam footage captures the frightening moment a caravan begins fishtailing while overtaking a truck driver in Western Australia's Great Southern region. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Will Corbett

item.title: Kangaroo skin sculpture honouring 'every survival story' wins Defence art prize
item.description: The Australian War Memorial is displaying highly commended pieces while people can vote online for a people's choice winner. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Tahlia Roy

item.title: CCTV shows Beau Lamarre-Condon outside home on day of double killing
item.description: Georgia Cook, a friend of former police officer Beau Lamarre-Condon, gave evidence at his murder trial on Friday and said she had met the defendant at a boat party in 2021. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jamie McKinnell

item.title: PM rejects ‘nonsense’ suggestion he delayed revealing OpenAI Medicare hack as Labor considers changing laws
item.description: Expert says Australia’s criminal laws should be clarified to determine how fault is applied to a corporation when its AI agent commits a crime Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our new political email , free app or daily news podcast The federal government could change Australian laws if the current legal framework could not respond to the unprecedented OpenAI hack of Medicare , ministers have confirmed. It comes as the prime minister denied accusations from the opposition he had held on to the information before announcing it at the UN general assembly in New York… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Krishani Dhanji

item.title: Bungled Sydney Water payroll rollout leaves workers underpaid
item.description: Three unions have voted for work stoppages and work bans after a new payroll system has been routinely paying employees incorrectly or late since July. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Declan Bowring

item.title: Dockers fans to marry outside the MCG during AFL grand final
item.description: Fremantle fans Danni Bloomfield and Matt Abbott have flown to Melbourne from Karratha to get married outside the MCG before watching their beloved Dockers contest the premiership. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Eleven-year-old boy shot in face at home in Australia dies after three days in hospital
item.description: Boy had been in critical condition since being found with gunshot wounds to face and neck Fuente: The Independent - World.
